user.title: Lunch planner
user.description: Name of this planner, e.g. the household it plans lunches for.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Add meals in the Lunch planner panel in the sidebar. Notifications and the shopping list are sent by automations: the integration's repository has ready blueprints for them.

data_description.meal_schedule: On work days, on the other days of the week (weekends), or every day.
data_description.workdays: Your work days; weekends are the other days. Not used with "Every day".
data_description.meal_mode: One course: soup or a main course. Two courses: soup and a main course.
data_description.soup_days: Only with "One course": how many lunches a week are soup. A day off can take a soup away with it.
data_description.soup_weekdays: Only with "One course": these days get the soups first. With more of them than soups, the soups go to some of them at random.
data_description.avoid_previous_week: Choose meals that were not served the week before, if the database allows it.
data_description.week_start: The weekly draw plans the week that starts on this day.
data_description.draw_weekday: The draw plans the next week. Best set it before the shopping for the first lunch of the week; a lunch whose shopping comes earlier is drawn on its own at midnight before its shopping day.
data_description.no_shopping_days: A lunch is bought the day before, or on the last open day before it. After a break of 3 days or more (e.g. Easter) it is bought in the morning of the lunch day instead.
data_description.days_off_calendars: No lunch on days with an all-day event in these calendars.
data_description.holiday_shops_closed: No shopping on the days of calendars from the Holiday integration. Other calendars (e.g. a holiday trip) cancel lunches only.
data_description.lunch_time: When lunch starts in the plan calendar.
data_description.lunch_duration: How long each lunch lasts in the plan calendar, in minutes.
data_description.show_panel: A sidebar panel with the plan and the meal database editor. Without it, manage meals with the add_meal and remove_meal actions.

error.no_workdays: Choose at least one work day.
error.no_weekend_days: With every day a work day there is no weekend: leave out a day or choose "Every day".
error.too_many_soup_days: There are fewer lunch days in a week than soup days.
error.no_shopping_day_left: Leave at least one day for shopping.

options.name: Name

redraw.description: Draws again one day, or every upcoming lunch whose shopping is not done yet.

config_entry_id.description: Needed only with more than one planner.

date.name: Date
date.description: Draw only this day. Leave empty for all upcoming lunches.

add_meal.name: Add meal
add_meal.description: Adds a meal to the database, or changes the meal with the same name in that category.

config_entry_id.name: Planner
config_entry_id.description: Needed only with more than one planner.

ingredients.name: What to buy
ingredients.description: One thing per line or separated by commas. Empty: the name goes on the shopping list.

season_from.name: Season from (month)
season_from.description: With "Season to": the meal is drawn only in these months.

active.name: Draw it
active.description: Off keeps the meal in the database without drawing it.

remove_meal.name: Remove meal
remove_meal.description: Removes a meal from the database.
